Expected numbers of patients, events and dropouts over calendar time

Source: R/ms_events.R
ms_events.Rd

Expected numbers of patients, events and dropouts over calendar time

Usage

ms_events(scenario, n, calendar_time, endpoint = c("os", "pfs"))

Arguments

scenario

An ms_scenario object.

n

Total sample size.

calendar_time

Calendar times from the start of the study.

endpoint

"os" or "pfs".

Value

A data frame with time, the numbers enrolled (enrolled, enrolled_control, enrolled_treatment), the expected events (events_control, events_treatment, events) and the expected dropouts (dropouts_control, dropouts_treatment).

Details

For group g with allocation probability p_g, the expected number of events by calendar time t is n p_g times the integral from 0 to t of A(t - s) f_g(s) G_g(s), where A is the enrolled fraction, f_g the density of the endpoint and G_g the probability of no dropout. The expected number of dropouts is obtained in the same way with the dropout density.

See also

ms_event_time, lr_moments

Examples

ctl <- ms_model(death = log(2) / 12, dropout = 0.005)
trt <- ms_model(death = 0.7 * log(2) / 12, dropout = 0.005)
scn <- ms_scenario(ctl, trt, accrual = ms_accrual(rate = 20))
ms_events(scn, n = 400, calendar_time = c(12, 24, 36))
#>   time enrolled enrolled_control enrolled_treatment events_control
#> 1   12      240              120                120       32.85127
#> 2   24      400              200                200      102.49878
#> 3   36      400              200                200      145.65790
#>   events_treatment    events dropouts_control dropouts_treatment
#> 1         24.47062  57.32188         2.843661           3.026026
#> 2         80.49241 182.99119         8.872469           9.953657
#> 3        121.46823 267.12613        12.608396          15.020710
